naslov: Chris Jones sinks game-winner at the buzzer as Crvena zvezda stun ASVEL
tekst:
By Nikola Miloradovic / info@eurohoops.net
Crvena zvezda Meridianbet snatched a dramatic 84-82 victory over ASVEL in Villeurbanne, as Chris Jones hit a stunning game-winner at the buzzer to cap off a thrilling finish.ASVEL had led for most of the contest, but Zvezda held firm when it mattered most.
After a crucial defensive stop in the final possession, the Belgrade side pushed in transition, with Jones taking responsibility and sinking a mid-range jumper just before the buzzer sounded.
Chima Moneke led Zvezda with 18 points, while Jordan Nwora added 17 and Semi Ojeleye contributed 15.
However, Jones stole the spotlight with the decisive shot, sending the visiting fans into celebration and securing Zvezda’s third consecutive EuroLeague win.
